themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties across Europe and the Americas are ramping up major campaign initiatives, forming strategic electoral pacts, and posting strong polling numbers. Marine Le Pen launched her 2027 French presidential campaign, Vox and the PP finalized a strategic Senate alliance in Spain, Norway's FrP reached record polling highs, and MAGA and Reform UK leadership staged key campaign rallies and policy blitzes ahead of upcoming votes.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen officially launched her 2027 presidential campaign in Orléans, promising a national renaissance and zero tolerance on crime.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox and the Popular Party secured a pact for Senate lists across multiple provinces to maximize right-wing representation.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP surged to a historic 35.3% in new polling, eclipsing the governing coalition and placing Sylvi Listhaug in a strong position.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and party leaders launched an 'Economic Rescue Plan' policy blitz to rally voters ahead of the UK budget.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and JD Vance headlined multiple midterm rallies across swing states including Kansas, South Carolina, and Michigan.

themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following Flávio Bolsonaro's runoff loss to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Brazil, right-wing leaders internationally have taken divergent stances on the result. While Donald Trump repeatedly labeled the election 'rigged,' Argentina's Javier Milei maintained a conspicuous silence that strained bilateral ties, even as Bolsonaro's Liberal Party officially recognized the outcome while court orders confiscated Bolsonaro's passports.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro challenged election aspects and was ordered to hand over passports, while his party PL accepted Lula's victory.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump repeatedly amplified claims that the Brazilian presidential runoff election was rigged against his conservative ally.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's deliberate refusal to congratulate Lula created domestic controversy and Heightened bilateral uncertainty with Brazil.

themes.title: US Diplomatic Backing for Viktor Orbán's International Stature
themes.blurb: High-level diplomatic coordination between the US conservative ecosystem and Hungary's ruling Fidesz party continues to elevate Prime Minister Viktor Orbán on the global stage. Reports that Donald Trump floated Orbán as a potential candidate for UN Secretary-General sparked intense debate, while Hungarian ministers met top US officials in Washington to preserve bilateral deals.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Figures in Trump's political orbit floated Viktor Orbán for international roles and hosted Hungarian diplomats in Washington.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian media and government officials reacted to high-level US backing and held talks with US officials to protect sanctions exemptions.

themes.title: Populist Energy Policies and Rollbacks of Climate Regulations
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are uniting around demands to slash energy taxes, rollback green regulations, and revive traditional fossil fuel industries. Marine Le Pen promised to repeal laws banning hydrocarbon exploration in France, Giorgia Meloni pushed the EU to modify the Emissions Trading System, and Poland's PiS introduced emergency lower-VAT energy legislation.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen pledged to abrogate green laws prohibiting hydrocarbon exploration to boost French energy sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged EU intervention on carbon trading costs to protect domestic heavy industry.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS submitted emergency legislative proposals to slash VAT on heating, electricity, and gas for Polish households.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK made repealing Net Zero commitments and lowering energy taxes central pillars of its national policy launch.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements across several nations face internal rifts and coalition friction over key foreign policy stances and tactical messaging. In Italy, Matteo Salvini's call to halt military aid to Ukraine sparked sharp rebukes from coalition partners, while internal ideological disputes over nationalism flared in Sweden, and massive email leaks rocked Germany's AfD.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini's demand to stop arming Ukraine triggered fierce pushback from foreign and defense ministers Tajani and Crosetto.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's foreign policy silence on Brazil created friction with mainstream coalition partners like Mauricio Macri.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The publication of hundreds of thousands of internal emails caused severe leadership stress and internal factional conflict.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Prominent SD figures clashed publicly online over whether Swedish national identity should be defined ethnically or culturally.
